verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has its own case management. Analysts can record a case decision ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted', 'risk detected- offboard'), and an API endpoint returns the audit log trail for a case, so decisions are captured in an investigation history. However, the evidence never shows analysts attaching evidence, writing free-text notes or comments, or giving decision rationale. Missing for 10: documented ability to add notes or comments to a case, evidence or document attachments, free-text decision reasons stored in the audit history, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
